soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 (binary reduction)
soundness_flags.one_line: The global declaration fixes q in {3,4,...}, so the statement's specialization q=2 is outside the typed domain; extend q's domain or state the binary specialization with separately declared symbols.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v2, 31 January 2026; author pages identify the accepted TMLR 2026 manuscript
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper is binary-latent, defines double triangularity, proves binary-view full rank and dimension exclusion, and identifies the binary model under additional conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and bibliographic record, lines 17 and 23-38
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper studies mixed-type observations and states identification through completeness/discretization and a two-sufficient-measurement condition.
The paper constructively recovers a binary or polytomous Q-matrix in a class with at least two pure items per attribute and leaves finite-sample singular-value replacement for future work.
The paper recovers latent graph structure through a mixture oracle, with no-twins, maximality, and nondegeneracy conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author-hosted copy corresponding to Annals of Statistics 37(6A), 2009, 3099-3132
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Three-view latent-class parameters are identifiable up to label swapping under the stated Kruskal-rank inequality, with a generic corollary.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the binary-reduction domain by declaring q∈{2,3,...} globally, then state exactly which q=2 assumptions and conclusions coincide with the cited binary theorem.

Make the fixed-K identification theorem explicitly isolate the new coordinate-alignment step that converts q^K mixture labels into K q-state coordinates and the latent MEC; this distinguishes it sharply from three-view Kruskal identification.
Turn the empirical OEQ into a sharper finite-dimensional testing target by fixing K,J,q and stating a bootstrap statistic, null strata, and uniform separation rate in κ.

recommended_next_step: Revise the q=2 typing defect, then advance the field-tier categorical certificate and identification kernel to Stage 0.
